nationality: 宋（洛阳，祖籍中山博野，今河北）
intellectual_tradition: 洛学开创者（明道之学），承周敦颐之教，与弟程颐并称'二程'
historical_significance: 程颢（1032—1085），字伯淳，世称明道先生，洛阳人，北宋理学家、洛学开山。嘉祐进士，历任鄠县、上元主簿，晋城令，太子中允权监察御史里行。早年与弟程颐师事周敦颐，'厌科举之业，慨然有求道之志'。他以'自家体贴出天理'二字为理学立命名，以《识仁篇》'仁者浑然与物同体'立境界论总纲，以《定性书》'动亦定，静亦定'立工夫论。其学气象宽平、如坐春风，朱熹尊之，陆九渊一系亦自认接其脉——明道之学成为后世'尊德性'与'道问学'两大路径共同的源头。门人朱光庭从学归来，人问所闻，答曰：'如坐春风中。'
core_thoughts: 天理二字（自家体贴出来：理为万物本体与当然之则）
仁者浑然与物同体（万物一体之仁）
动亦定静亦定（定性：情顺万事而无情）
以觉训仁（知觉活泼为仁之验，如痿痹之别）
勿忘勿助（工夫的火候论）
生生之谓易（观天地生生之意）
鸢飞鱼跃（道在日用常行）
善恶皆天理（不以善恶废天理之全体）
放这身来万物中一例看（平等观物）
随材成就（春风化雨的教育法）
famous_quote: 仁者浑然与物同体（《识仁篇》）；天地之间，只是一个感遂通（《二程遗书》）；吾学虽有所受，天理二字却是自家体贴出来
influence: 程颢以'天理'为理学命名——'吾学虽有所受，天理二字却是自家体贴出来'，从此'理'成为此后八百年中国哲学的核心范畴。'仁者浑然与物同体'直接塑造了王阳明'万物一体'之论；《定性书》以'廓然而大公，物来而顺应'回应张载'定性未能不动'之问，成为宋明工夫论的经典文本。其气象宽厚如春风，与程颐严肃如秋霜相对，形成洛学内部'尊德性'与'道问学'两脉：心学自认接明道之脉，程朱一系奉其与伊川并尊。任晋城令时以乡校、保甲、劝农实政著称，证明其学非虚谈性命。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《识仁篇》：'仁者浑然与物同体，义礼智信皆仁也。识得此理，以诚敬存之而已，不须防检，不须穷索。'——把伦理的根放在'万物一体'的存在体验上，德目只是这一体的展开。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: In Recognizing Ren: 'The humane person forms one body with all things; righteousness, propriety, wisdom, and faith are all ren.' Ethics is grounded in the experience of oneness, not in rule-following.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '吾学虽有所受，天理二字却是自家体贴出来。'——师承有自，而体系命名之核心命题须自家体贴：承认传承与主张亲证并行不悖。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Though I had teachers, the two characters Tianli (Heavenly Principle) I worked out through my own personal realization.' Lineage received, but the core insight must be self-attained.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《定性书》：'所谓定者，动亦定，静亦定；无将迎，无内外……廓然而大公，物来而顺应。'——定不是不动，而是任何情境下心体皆自定；情感'顺应'而非压抑。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: In On Calming the Nature: 'The settled is settled in motion and in stillness alike—no sending ahead, no trailing behind... vast and impartial, responding to things as they come.' Stillness is not immobility.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '医书言手足痿痹为不仁，此言最善名状。仁者以天地万物为一体，莫非己也。'——借医家'痿痹'反训仁：知觉通活即是仁，麻木不仁即失一体之感。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Medical texts call numbness of limb 'not-ren'—nothing names it better. The humane take heaven-and-earth and all things as one body.' Ren as sensitivity: numbness as the failure of felt connection.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '必有事焉而勿正，心勿忘，勿助长也'（引孟子）——工夫的火候：既不能忘（放任），也不能助（强制），中间持守正是修养最难处。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Have it ever in view, but without forcing: never forget it, never help it grow.' The doctrine of proper timing in cultivation—neither neglect nor compulsion.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '天地之大德曰生……万物之生意最可观，此元者善之长也，斯所谓仁也。'——从天地生生不息处直接观仁：仁不是抽象规范，是宇宙的创生倾向在人心中的同构。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'The great virtue of heaven and earth is life-generating... most observable is the vital impulse of things—this is ren.' Ren read as the cosmic generative tendency resonating in the human.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '鸢飞戾天，鱼跃于渊，言其上下察也……此一节子思喫紧为人处。'——道不在玄远而在鸢飞鱼跃的日常显现场所；真见道者于极平实处见极活泼。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'The hawk soars to heaven; the fish leaps in the deep—studying above and below.' The Way is found in ordinary manifestations, vivid in the commonplace.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '天下善恶皆天理，谓之恶者非本恶，但或过或不及便如此。'——恶不是本体之外的存在，而是善之'过与不及'的偏斜：从同一根源理解正与邪，避免把恶实体化。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Good and evil throughout the world are both Heavenly Principle: what is called evil is not originally evil, but excess or deficiency.' Evil as deviation, not as a rival substance.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '放这身来，都在万物中一例看，大小大快活。'——把'我'从中心位移入万物之中平列观察：自我中心解除后的存在之乐，是'与物同体'的入门操作。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Place this body of mine among the myriad things and view it as one instance among them—what great joy!' Decentering the self as the entry operation of oneness.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 朱光庭受学而归，人问所得，曰：'光庭在春风中坐了一月。'程颢教人'各随其材而有作'，怒于中者未尝形于外——教育以涵养气象、顺应材质为法，而非灌输规条。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Zhu Guangting returned from study saying, 'I sat for a month in spring wind.' Cheng Hao taught each according to his capacities, anger never showing in his face—education by cultivating atmosphere and following aptitude.

tags: 仁者以天地万物为一体

cross_references.description_zh: 张载问'定性未能不动，犹累于外物'，程颢答以《定性书》：定不在'拒外物'而在'物来顺应'——张载欲以强制隔离达静，程颢指出动静皆定的路径。同一问题，一个向外隔离求静，一个向内廓然大公；这封信是北宋理学两大工夫进路的正面交锋与和解。
cross_references.description_en: Zhang Zai asked how to settle the nature while still burdened by external things; Cheng Hao's reply, On Calming the Nature, relocated stillness from blocking the world to responding to it impartially—two opposing yet complementary paths of cultivation.

cross_references.description_zh: 周敦颐令二程'寻孔颜乐处'，程颢以此问终身受用，答为'仁者浑然与物同体'——但把周氏'主静'的工夫入口翻转为'动亦定静亦定'：静不再是特权状态，任何处境中心体皆可定。师授之问与弟子之答构成理学境界论的代际完成。
cross_references.description_en: Zhou Dunyi posed 'seek the joy of Confucius and Yan Hui'; Cheng Hao's lifelong answer was 'forming one body with all things'—while inverting Zhou's anchor-in-stillness into 'settled in motion and stillness alike.'

cross_references.description_zh: 郭象以'独化'主张万物各自独生于玄冥，彼此无待；程颢以'浑然与物同体'主张万物一体、血脉相连。同样面对'物与物如何安顿'的问题，一个强调各自的独立性，一个强调整体的关联性——两种相反的形上温度，均为回应世界分崩时代的精神方案。
cross_references.description_en: Guo Xiang's self-transformation asserts each thing arises independently; Cheng Hao's ren asserts all things form one body. Opposite metaphysical temperaments—independence versus interconnection—answering the same fractured world.

modern_value_zh: 万物一体思维——把'我'重新放进关系网络中定义，是生态伦理、系统思维与'利益相关者治理'的古典原型
定性工夫——'动亦定静亦定'提供情绪管理的高阶方案：不是躲开扰动，而是在任何情境下保持内在自定
以觉训仁——用'敏感度/知觉通活'定义组织与关系的健康度：麻木即'不仁'，可作团队体检指标
勿忘勿助——目标管理中的火候论：既不遗忘也不硬逼，适用于习惯养成、组织变革与教育
善恶皆天理——把偏差理解为'过与不及'而非'敌对实体'，是从容处理错误与异见的思维基础
modern_value_en: One-body thinking: defining the self within a web of relations—classical prototype of ecological ethics and stakeholder governance
Settledness in motion and stillness: emotion regulation by inner stability in any context, not by avoiding disturbance
Ren as sensitivity: numbness as diagnostic of unhealthy teams and relationships—a felt-responsiveness metric
Neither forget nor force: the doctrine of proper effort for habit change, transformation, and education
Evil as excess or deficiency: reading deviation as imbalance rather than enemy-entity—the basis of tolerant error handling
place_of_origin: 洛阳（祖籍中山博野，今河北定州一带）
unique_thing: 程颢的核心成就是一次'命名工程'与'境界工程'的合一：他为整个理学找到了名字——'天理'二字'自家体贴出来'，使理学从此有了本体论旗帜；又为理学找到了最高的精神画面——'仁者浑然与物同体'，使道德不再是规训而成为存在的充盈状态。他的著作极少（《识仁篇》不足三百字、《定性书》一封信），且终生未成体系大著，却同时是心学（陆王）与理学（程朱）两脉共同追认的源头。这证明：体系奠基有时不靠论证的重量，而靠'体贴'——把一个前人未名而人人隐约感到的东西，用最准确的名字与画面呈现出来。
